pr.title: feat(brand): Direction B palette cutover — error→red, success→green, AA fix
pr.body:
## Summary
- Cuts over `src/dopemux/ui/theme.py` to Direction B Electric Refresh palette
- Fixes error slot: `#FF8BD1` (pink/magenta) → `#FF2255` (hot rose-red, ANSI-red-family, hue 346°)
- Fixes success slot: `#94FADB` (cyan-colliding mint) → `#00FF85` (neon green, ANSI-green-family, hue 151°)
- Fixes `text.muted`: `#64748B` (AA-fail 4.31) → `#808DA0` (WCAG AA 5.99)
- Demotes gremlin-pink `#FF00CC` to accent-only (no status use)
- Updates BRAND_SYSTEM.md: danger doctrine changed to red-family
- Updates brand_lint.py / sync_brand_tokens.py enforcement gates

## Scope
- `src/dopemux/ui/theme.py` — palette values only, no key removals
- `BRAND_SYSTEM.md` — doctrine section only
- `scripts/sync_brand_tokens.py` + `scripts/brand_lint.py` — gate values only
- No web surfaces, no Textual TCSS, no new deps

## Validation
- brand_lint.py PASS
- ANSI maps: success=green, error=red, warning=yellow, info=cyan, aftercare=blue
- WCAG AA verified by compute: all status tokens ≥4.5 on `#020617`
- No stale `#FF8BD1` or `#FF00FF` refs in theme.py
- Existing style key list unchanged (no removals)

validation: Old hex refs located and flagged for removal.

Update build_theme() style map: error→bold #FF2255, success→#00FF85, and all derived chip/bar/panel styles that referenced the old pink or mint.
Update ANSI-16 low_color fallback: pink→magenta entry must become error→red (bold red), success entry → bold green.
Update text.muted to #808DA0.
Do NOT remove any existing key from the Theme dict.
Do NOT change any key name.
